hook: Nandy spent over 15 years building the infrastructure behind Google's core advertising and analytics businesses, systems used by billions of people, before leading product and engineering at Okta's identity platform and now steering Docusign's shift toward AI-driven agreement management as CTO.
name: Sagnik Nandy

quote.text: With 18+ years of experience in the technology industry, I have a proven track record of delivering high-impact and scalable solutions for some of the most challenging and complex problems in security, digital advertising, data processing and analytics, machine learning and infrastructure.
quote.context: Sagnik Nandy, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief Technology Officer at Docusign, Former Google VP

timeline.event: Joins Google, leading the Analytics and Measurement product suite
Becomes VP of Engineering, Display Advertising
timeline.impact: Leads AdMob, Ad Manager, and AdSense

timeline.event: Becomes VP of Engineering, Search Ads
Joins Okta as CTO and President of Technology
Named President and Chief Development Officer, Okta
timeline.impact: Company-wide product, engineering, and design leadership

quick_facts: Chief Technology Officer at Docusign, leading its move into Intelligent Agreement Management
Previously President and Chief Development Officer at Okta, overseeing Product, Engineering, and Design
Spent over 15 years at Google, rising to VP of Engineering over Search Ads and Display Advertising
Operating Advisor at Bessemer Venture Partners; PhD in Computer Science and Engineering from UC San Diego

achievements.title: Chief Technology Officer, Docusign (2024-present)
achievements.impact: Leads the company's move from e-signature into Intelligent Agreement Management, applying AI to a widely used enterprise workflow.

achievements.title: President and Chief Development Officer, Okta
achievements.impact: Oversaw Product, Engineering, and Design for Okta's Workforce Identity Cloud, a leading enterprise identity and access management platform.

achievements.title: Vice President of Engineering, Search Ads, Google
achievements.impact: Led infrastructure, ads quality, targeting, and bidding for the core systems responsible for a significant share of Google's advertising revenue.

achievements.title: VP of Engineering, Display Advertising, Google
achievements.impact: Managed Google AdMob, Ad Manager, and AdSense, the publisher ad platforms serving much of the web's display advertising.

achievements.title: Distinguished Engineer / Senior Director, Analytics and Measurement, Google
achievements.impact: Managed Google Analytics, Firebase Analytics, Tag Manager, and related measurement products over a decade-long tenure.
